snippet.title: I Opened the Walls and Found Something Beautiful - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
You've found something that's changed the way you see. The world is more than you thought. The walls have opened.

I Opened the Walls and Found Something Beautiful is a short, experimental cosmic horror exploration game available now for free on itch.io.

https://mike-richards.itch.io/i-opened-the-walls-and-found-something-beautiful
